main.description: A like on a fans.foryour.post, held in the LIKER's own repo (never the creator's). Public: like records ride the open AT network exactly as app.bsky.feed.like does, and — for a like on a PUBLIC post — a foryour.fans-compatible app pairs it with an app.bsky.feed.post like so Bluesky renders the count too. Unlike = delete this record. Structurally identical to app.bsky.feed.like's `subject`; the shape is inlined as `#subject` rather than referencing com.atproto.repo.strongRef, matching fans.foryour.post's `#recordRef`/`#mediaRef` convention (this package does not codegen com.atproto.* refs).

subject.description: Strong reference (AT URI + CID) to the fans.foryour.post being liked. Match on `uri` only — a post edit re-mints the CID under the same rkey, so an older like's `cid` is a stale integrity anchor, not a join key.

createdAt.description: Client-declared timestamp when the like was created.

subject.description: A com.atproto.repo.strongRef-shaped pointer: AT URI plus the CID of the referenced record at like time.
